notes: Strip d: x 4970-6500 plus ~300 px overlap. Names: Victory Blvd printed VICTORY ... BLVD.; Woodburn printed WOODBURN/AVENUE (vertical part north of Madison, then the long SW diagonal); Montgomery printed MONT. only; Lincoln west of Woodburn printed only ...AVE. (stray R near x 4720) but it is the street printed LINCOLN further west (x~2900), and it jogs ~106 px at Woodburn; Clayton jogs ~108 px at Hackberry. Durrell Avenue is in two parts: north part Gilbert->Victory junction (~4800,2215); south part Lincoln->Chapel, continuing the line of Victory Blvd at 60 ft. Taft: printed TAFT; 'ST.' printed far east (x~9100) on the same road, so recorded as Taft Street (uncertain; may be Taft Road). Moorman: no suffix seen, recorded as Moorman Avenue. Unnamed (?): the 50 ft avenue from Madison to Clayton at x~6045 (printed AVE. only), the avenue going south off the plate at x~5465 (printed AVE.), and the street going south off the plate at x~6406. Hackberry drifts west going south (6592 at Hewitt to 6475 at Taft) and has inner double lines; centres are midway between block lines. Taft and Hewitt have one side on the plate edge.
